objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type/level classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: The abbreviation and consecutive number assigned to the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document version is valid, set upon release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The configurable period for validity checks, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The configurable period for archiving before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope or areas of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, or IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas for which the document is valid.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language of the document content.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original Office format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the main document release.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment not subject to a release cycle, published directly via property switches, with no effect on the main document version.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changes to an existing document, managed independently without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, triggering a workflow to check and extend document validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggered when a document has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined authorization group in the system used to assign read and change rights to a group of users for documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles and authorizations on documents.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system role assigned to the person (e.g. Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Reader).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The list of user groups and persons assigned to receive a document via email notification or for acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance that supports approval, review, release, validity extension, override, or reactivation processes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The time at which the signature was provided.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected document type for the new document.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically converted to PDF after saving and the current version is displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_by_author
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of Creator.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the content of the document according to technical and formal aspects during the review workflow step.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Technical check or formal check.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document in the release workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which rejection occurred (review or release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of the document is created, either from revision of a released document or triggered by attachment changes or change proposal implementation.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The reason for new version creation (e.g. content change, attachment change, change proposal, reactivation).

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is deleted from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by an employee with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, marking it as completed.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed through the workflow by releaser or by author, reviewer, and releaser.

attributes.name: process_variant
attributes.description: Variant 1 (releaser only) or Variant 2 (author, reviewer, releaser).

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is extended by confirming the additional validity, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A request for override (AKS) is created for a document that has no additional validity and must be withdrawn.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through the workflow by releaser or by initiator, reviewer, and releaser.

attributes.name: process_variant
attributes.description: Variant 1 (releaser only) or Variant 2 (initiator, reviewer, releaser).

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group, and the archive duration begins.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, documents are physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by the Business Admin group for a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document with retained metadata and restored authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are informed by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A person on the distribution list confirms acknowledgement of the released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A released document is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is reviewed and released through a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read, write).

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or pending actions.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: The type of notification (e.g. workflow task, validity extension, override, change proposal, acknowledgement).
